notes.title: Prison Survival Playtests Has Begun!
notes.content:
[p]Hello Prisoners!

[/p][h2]We're excited to announce that playtests for Prison Survival are now live![/h2][p]
[/p][h2]You can join starting today, July 24, until August 7.[/h2][p]
To join the playtest, simply visit our Prison Survival's Steam page and click “Request Access” - access will be granted automatically.

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1983910/"][/dynamiclink]

[/p][h1] 🔥What is in this playtest? [/h1][p]
Prison Survival is a first-person prison stealth-action game set in a semi-open prison environment. 
You’re free to explore – but some areas are off-limits. 
Enter a Restricted Area, and guards or security cameras will be on your tail. 
If they catch you – you're sent back to a checkpoint.

You can run, hide, or use parkour to escape – climb pipes, ledges, or sneak through ventilation shafts. You can also fight other inmates with your fists!

The art style is slightly stylized, but we’re keeping the gritty prison atmosphere: gangs, drugs, fights, foul language, and the daily grind of prison life!

[/p][previewyoutube="wKjJcNnzYjo;full"][/previewyoutube][p]

[/p][h1]🔥 What is your goal in Prison Survial Playtest?[/h1][p]
You work for a prison boss. Your job? Smuggle contraband – drugs, weapons, and other illegal items.
Pick up orders, avoid or take down guards, use parkour, disable cameras, fight rival inmates, deliver the goods and get back to your cell and go to sleep ;)

You can also buy helpful tools (like lockpicks, remote camera disablers, or a map), or train parkour in a dedicated area!

[/p][h1]📢 Join Our Community![/h1][p]
Visit our Discord for FAQ, control explanations, and to grab the press kit !

[/p][h1]📋Deliver your message![/h1][p]
[h2]Press F5 during a game to report a bug or a suggestion![/h2]
We need your feedback! Help us and become a part of Prison Survival!

[h1] 👀Invite your friends![/h1]

notes.title: Details about new update coming to full version of Prison Simulator!
notes.content:
[h1]Players and Officers! New important informations about full version of [b]Prison Simulator[/b] ![/h1]

Hello and welcome to the devlog about our new mode we are adding in Prison Simualtor!!
We are working now on several things right now and one of it is a absolutely [b]new[/b] mode in Prison Simulator! This new mode will be distributed [b]for free[/b] ! 

[h2]Last Man Standing - what are the rules?[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/4768ae54be6d512a6500c84b19b06412de24be9b.gif[/img]

The rules is simple - get out of prison alive !! The vile riot is destroying prison facility. You have no other choice but to escape ! (it's funny that the guard must escape prison, right?)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/97843b0c3248075f4a2d63364312878868e6375e.gif[/img]

This mode is actually action-oriented. We know that you liked a Riot Event from full game a lot ;) so we added some more action in prison for fans ;)

[h2]Getting started[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/c4838c3406dbde0b3bfdbaafe439a55f6585f700.gif[/img]

First you will find yourself without weapons or items in small office...  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/dbf8530693e68a355ec8a6be395dd607d943654c.gif[/img]

You got only your trusty fists! Fight your way out! Persuading won't help you this time - prisoners are mad and wants your blood!! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/14c31b852f600897d6b5a223a7cb25f7ffe99c18.gif[/img]

Use fists to fight! Remember you can press RMB to defend yourself. But watch a [b]stamina bar[/b] !!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/bc142de2c3a6ebf5cd4ee2812c46086ef76218f7.gif[/img]

Also you can HOLD an attack button to charge a powerfull PUNCH ! No one can resist that !

[h2]This is where a fun begins![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/7d14e81c23e2edf8b54ed8172869e3933615a493.gif[/img]

Fortunately in this mess and riot you can still find some usefull items. A riot gun is mandatory, i haven't finished this mode without it ever once :D  
And don't worry about prisoners health - it works on non-lethal bullets !

[h2]Stronger enemies[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/b34e4a92cfa13fb1f0888ef1f26c924d3d9cfd09.gif[/img]

In one of the updates we added some stronger prisoners to Riot Event. 
Unfortunately they came back for more!! Watch out for mini-bosses with stolen body armor and weapons and also for a tricky ones with GUNS!! Most dangerous ones! You have to defeat them in order to progress through some rooms

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/34cfd1c505fc0b8beae4021e2d3b421d89fa51d9.gif[/img]

[h2]Entarily new prison![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/45d99ce905fb10090f67e57d06e3322c01866328.gif[/img]

We made a entairly new prison for this mode ! It was fun making it ! Hope you won't get lost ;)
After escaping (or after death) you will get a pop up with some informations of how well did you 
did. You know: time passed, prisoners neutralized etc. Try to aim for the best score!

I hope this mode will get you some challenge and fun! It's [b]almost[/b] ready to be published, please be patient and wait for some more info about future of Prison Simulator - you won't be dissapointed ;)

notes.title: Inside the Gameplay: Even more Prison Guard Daily Routines PART 2
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/72cb15d6d04da37a3c9064bab29abc6037a0ff3a.jpg[/img]
I hope you're ready to learn what else awaits you in the full version of Prison Simulator.
The game launches on November 4th exclusively on Steam.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/0d7891c4ddfb1bd6e0591a68a0a7105938725704.jpg[/img]
[h1]Workshop[/h1]
While in Prison, all inmates have is time. So why not make them more productive and earn some cash for the Prison? So each day bunch of inmates works shifts in the workshop. 

Your role is to pick the perfect guys for the tasks. (If you screw this up and select the members of rival gangs, they will beat the shit out of each other). 
Assign them to their stations and make sure that all of them actually work. 

But you know how it is. Accidents happen, and someone might get hurt; there are times when they might misuse the blowtorch (def not by accident), and you'll need to search for your inner firefighter. 

But you can always decide to make your prisoners work overtime to work off the damage. The decision is yours.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/d5805d37c8a067212f9e4e6de2f400a7d033ca89.jpg[/img]
[h1]Searching packages[/h1]
Drugs, tools, weapons. You won't believe what these convicts will get in their packages. And their close ones tend to be very creative in smuggling prohibited items. So your job is to search through all the boxes. 
If you overlook anything - your fellow prison guards will lose respect for ya. Things might get ugly.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/b7d160008303a5f9024607bac6c18b3a7c4d7642.jpg[/img]
[h1]Visiting Room[/h1]

Family and friends visiting the Prisoners is their only occasion to have contact with the outside world. But you know – Prison is the place where Convicts should obey rules. And one rule about having guests is that – you cannot spend there all day. Your job is to make sure that the visit is not too long and that you keep your inmates' emotions in check. (yup, especially those negative ones)
 
But you know – as a Prison Guard, you have a choice. You can let someone sit a bit longer (for a bribe ofc), but it may come with a price. Of what kind? You can check for yourself.
 
Did I mention that this Prison also has a special room for more "intimate encounters"? 😉
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/6ea28a45390a7c220a2af1a516f5ea33b04f0f36.jpg[/img]
[h1]Monitoring[/h1]

Observe your Inmates and check if they're not doing anything malicious. In case of any suspicious behaviors – look for the closest CO and guide him. 
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/3bf611841a937720e63f22a94d96585d5fc578b0.jpg[/img]
[h1]Checking the applications[/h1]
 
Prisoners have a right to ask for a release due to special occasions like a funeral. Sometimes they want to file a complaint or a request.
And some of them are filing for a pardon. So you have to dig through that paper, check all the signatures, stamps, and content of these documents before you Approve or Deny someone's application. 

Double-check – cause mistakes in this field have consequences.
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/ecfaae96ea45e338e32e7519476c3c67dda23030.jpg[/img]
[h1] Execution[/h1]
 
Among all your Prisoners, there will be ones who committed the most brutal crimes. The only journey that waits for them is the one to the Death Cell. And your job is to escort them… and manage the whole process. While the entire experience is rather grim, there're rules and you need to ensure that everything is in check.
 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/9ce0e63ff392aba27cf572b27fedda1eb6156be4.jpg[/img]
[h1]Releasing the Prisoners[/h1]
 
Before you release a Prisoner, you need to follow the utmost detail of the procedure. Check if all documents are correct, search him. If everything is ok – you're good to give him back his belongings and release him to the rest of the society.

notes.title: Inside Gameplay: Prison Guard Daily Routines PART 1
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/0138274a3aa2ce2db0b97075bfc78ca5286045cc.jpg[/img]

I bet you're curious about all the things you'll be able to do in the full version of Prison Simulator. So without further ado - let's dive into all the Routines you need to perform as a Prison Guard. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/e00de33e0bbb1f7c9c4b6fd6537ee8cdf6c8f10e.jpg[/img]
[h1][b]Cell Shakedown[/b][/h1]

You don't want any contraband and illegal stuff to go unnoticed under your command, do you? So check out every inch of the cells. 
Trust me - inmates are desperate. They will hide stuff even in the shitter. 
Once you find some hidden stashes, it's up to you to decide what are you gonna do with your findings. 

Are you gonna do the right thing and confiscate the stashed stuff? Or maybe you'll leave it where it was? Or take it for yourself? 


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/948233e4d46c316bc35ffecf4987feb8eec15c81.jpg[/img]
[h1]Prisoners' Reception[/h1]

You're the "Welcome Committee " for the new Prisoners. Your job as a Prison Guard is to make sure that you're taking in the right guy. That means - fingerprints and documentation checks. (You don't want to bring in the wrong guy, do you?) 
Check the personal items that the new guy wants to bring in (you won't believe what people can smuggle in a shampoo bottle). 
Give away the pack of basic supplies and wish "good luck" to this poor sod. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/44bef1ce7316aa98e0b1eb715c4599f53be4618a.jpg[/img]
[h1]Prison Yard[/h1]

Even these poor Jail bastards need to take a breath of fresh air. But don't forget that they're still a bunch of degenerates who need constant supervision. So have an eye on everyone. Stop the fights! Punish the vandals! 
Hell - you can even order them to get back in the cells if they don't know how to behave. You're calling the shots. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/b23e29b4a6bd85c964a1bad4a10c2d985b82b5bf.jpg[/img]
[h1]Cafeteria [/h1]
 
You need to make sure that no one will start a riot over the spoon of a mush. So maintain peace and order at any cost. No fights, shouting in the mess hall. So if any of that happens, you need to be swift on your feet and act quickly. 
If it seems that they won't obey, you're allowed to use force. Or try to solve the problem verbally. It's up to you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/61b09759763821f596fbe11680939ad40f5a31fc.jpg[/img]
[h1]Attendance Check[/h1]

The best way to check is if you don't have any fugitives here. First, arm yourself with your trusty clicker. Then, open every cell in the block and start the counting. Of course, some of your Prisoners won't cooperate. That's where you need to use your "persuasion" techniques. You can either yell at someone, make him step out of his cell, or just count him either way. Your choice.

But remember - you need to have them in check. 


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/d90536199fdc607be6104cfea644e2f378ca8253.jpg[/img]
[h1]Shower[/h1]

I'm waiting for all the jokes in the comments ;) 
But srsly - hygiene is essential. Every person who has been in the men's locker room knows that. Here is no different. There are too many inmates and too few showers. So your job is to assign prisoners to empty cabins. Check out the washed-out and still make sure that they are on their best behavior. Is someone taking too much time, and that makes everyone waiting and getting angry? You know what to do - act as a Prison Guard would. 

This is the first part of the quick look at the Routines available in the full version of Prison Simulator.

notes.title: Prison Simulator: Dealing with prisoners? Not in my prison.
notes.content:
[b]hello Officers,[/b]

We don't have good news today. Our senior CO caught several other guards trading with inmates. 

One of them got so deep into the business that he just said goodbye to his job! If you enjoy your job, don't go that way. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/9ee79319ec6856b3db6eead838242f2f470fa39e.png[/img]

It would be the end of our warden. Therefore, what happens in this prison stays in this prison. It's hard, but it has to be that way.

notes.title: Prison Simulator: Bad prisoners... really bad prisoner!
notes.content:
Hello Officers,

Our prisoner is relaxing instead of working.  It looks like the CO is already very upset. Generally, according to prison rules, it should not happen that way for a guard to not control his emotions, but we are only human and sometimes these situations happen.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38933921/7ac6f376c25e9bd599b52c78b1137ecee33b4a07.png[/img]

It is important that you do not go too far. We always start by trying to have a conversation. Let our inmate know that his behavior is unacceptable. If that doesn't help, we have a choice of different ways to force our inmate to return to work.

One of them is the baton. Two solid hits across his back and he should return to work begging for peace on his own. However, if our delinquent is stubborn, sometimes you just have to remind him who irules this prison.

In addition to the baton, we also have pepper spray, although we use it more to pacify aggressive prisoners, and a taser, which should also not be used as a means of first response. 

You must keep your eyes open during the workshop routine. Sometimes inmates will stand at their workstation and pretend to work, but when you get closer you will find out that it's just a pretense, and our inmate is obviously slacking off. 

Also be vigilant during the search. You never know where prisoners will decide to hide a hammer or a file. We don't mean to imply anything - sometimes you just might be surprised.

All tools should be returned to the storage room immediately after the search is complete. Occasionally, someone may try to bribe you to keep these stolen screws or other items in their equipment.
Of course you are not supposed to agree to this, but if you do, remember that the consequences can be unforgivable!

Once one of the guards allowed an inmate to take a file. We patched up the hole in the fence for 3 days. Well! Remember to keep an eye on these degenerates.

End of roll call,, go back to your work.

Thank you so much for reading our update. If you want to try Prison Simulator: Prologue, you can add it to your wishlist!

notes.content:

How's your week going? Are the inmates causing any problems? We hope our training in pacifying these bastards has helped you a lot.

Unfortunately, we have some bad news. We recently had a strange case of six deaths in one week. The guards in Block C are complaining that they can't do anything with it, and the morgue staff are already refusing to take any more dead bodies.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/4f9f051bde41172789b3a63f707e3749f277a50d.png[/img]

If you would be so kind as to help them out a little? We don't want our prison to make the headlines as a place to dispose of the margins of society.

If any of you haven't been to the morgue yet, unfortunately you'll have to wait a bit longer. Access is granted to guards of the full version. 


[b]Bug fixes[/b]

We recently received a report of an elastic man walking around our prison - well, not everyone should go out in the sun. We dealt with the problem and no one scares anyone anymore.

The toothpaste has lost its magical properties and its model no longer goes through the parcels. 

Our warden was listening to the radio so loudly that it could be heard across the hall. Fortunately, a gentle reminder worked and now you can enjoy the peace and quiet. 

And perhaps most importantly, occasionally an inmate would disappear during the evening attendance check, but fortunately our new security measures have had the desired effect and everything is now ok.

That's everything for today. We hope the end of this week will be pleasant and easy for you.

Unfortunately, inmate satisfaction has a huge impact on our facility's overall ranking. So we cannot allow them to live (as prisoners should) in humble, grey, dirty cells.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/66b18cc25a7edf357bb16813f858a29c4ef73f3f.jpg[/img]

In the computer you will find access to an online store that offers all kinds of equipment for our cells. You can find everything you need there, from beds and bedding to lockers and chairs. If we can afford it, you can even buy those bastards gold bars. Just to keep the prison running.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/db7a4111a7c5503c687bdf7401aeb4fbfd079103.jpg[/img]

[b]Another thing, probably one of the most important.[/b]

The cabinets above the sink are a cluster of illegal items. Be careful. New objects mean new challenges. Of course, don't forget that the delinquent himself may also have something in his pants. Who knows what other ideas they will come up with and where they will decide to hide their possessions.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/2f2d38e7188935043d1cf115b70e387c2953a18a.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Prison Simulator: Block B and the routines
notes.content:
[b]Hey Officers,[/b]

Today we're going to take a quick look at Block B. This is where our polite (or not) convicts spend most of their time. Here they have the best basic equipment in the world like a toilet, sink and bed. I remember when in the 70's the warden ordered to put gold bars in the cells, to replace the toilets and they even had chairs!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38933921/03bfd462d8b713694395d7ccffbd0c129165e0ee.jpg[/img]

Those were weird days, but later they sold everything because money started to run out!

There's a lot of work here, too. Every morning you have to come in here and get those naughty people out of their cells. There is no sleeping until noon. In the evening the situation suddenly changes and our morning sleepers do not even think about returning to their cells. What a surprise.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38933921/dd51bbe615c09dd7233f479e3af70dcae4063d6a.jpg[/img]

Then there were two options left: either you talk or you pull out a baton.
Unfortunately, there is no other option, no one will ask them to kindly return to their bunks.

During your leisure time, we sometimes visit this place too. Sometimes the inmates would like to tell us the story of their lives, and these boring stories are good for your boredom.

If you're a good guy and have contacts, you can also trade, but as far as I know, that's what the man in the guards' room teaches. He's the boss in that area. 

There are also requests for cigarettes or other sweets, well it's up to you what you do with it, but I always have a chocolate bar with me. In case of rebellion I am not afraid for my ass.

Sometimes they will ask you if you can pass something to someone, or if you can turn a blind eye to those beautiful razor blades, hammers and other illegal items in their packages, or if you can give someone a gentle beating - although gentle is not always the case.

People think officer work is such a boring, tedious job.
Actually, you have a lot of opportunities, but if you want, sitting on the bench is really cool too.

[b]That's probably all we wanted to tell you today. The prologue is getting closer, and in the meantime, feel free to add our game to your wishlist to get notified when it's ready![/b]

notes.title: Prison Simulator: Prologue - Achievements Reveal
notes.content:
[h2]Hello Guards,[/h2]

You've been working very diligently these past few months, the inmates even tolerate you, but...

Can you handle the latest challenge that Prison Simulator: Prologue will throw at you? Can you get them all?

[h3]All right, enough with the serious motivational speech, time for Friday's news![/h3]

In [b]Prison Simulator: Prologue[/b] you will be able to see some of the achievements that you are familiar with from the demo version. The decision to include them in the next part was based on the complexity of the gameplay in the prologue itself.

Which of the achievements will return, you will see for yourselves, in the meantime we will present to you the achievements that you don't know yet.

[b]1.Not on my watch![/b]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/0bfb0f866522fcb09417e97be94d92b85119b76e.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/105062088b9aa9b87d511d1752998f69dee444c4.png[/img][/url]

This achievement is one of the easiest and hardest at the same time. To get it, all you have to do (or as much as) is master rebellion. Simple right? Not one daredevil has tried to do it, but not one has fallen in the fight against the convicts.

[b]2 - Diplomat[/b]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/630d49025071e628b1597ad68e0eda9f90bd1c44.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/e4872f0b03184e27b0bc03005dec1d3f2f77ecee.png[/img][/url]

What's there to say. We solve problems with talk, not fists. So much for that. And if you don't like talking, there are only fists left, but this achievement won't be for you.

[b]3 No guns allowed[/b]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/ffd06485fff10fc1aee826e493ff75e5bd4d283f.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/e4b5ee4845e4a9679f2c51f4f6dfb052ee08e403.png[/img][/url]

This achievement is reserved for true professionals. The prison is on fire, the convicts are vandalizing everything they can, the guards are running scared... and in the middle of it all - YOU. The hero of the prison, the guard of all guards, who deals with such problems without reaching for a gun. Is it a dream or a reality?

[b]4. The story begins[/b]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/0633869e0fdad85d0c19a82a4d628ed96f72ad1b.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/2abcf9b934d522711c19e7a81752a41692411bb3.png[/img][/url]

This achievement is for persistent players who complete Prison Simulator: Prologue. And that's it. 

[b]5. Finders keepers[/b]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/98bffe0bda00735b9de118096c051c36eab242ad.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/2a1e45cd8bd89ff06bc00b095ea9d9a0f68adbee.png[/img][/url]

Fortunately, our prison facility... Oops, it's not that easy!

[b]6. Student[/b]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/a32d85b1c94754b044caaed2f2adaaf89362a2ec.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/8f3a48ef6c8dc95dcdc5a8d94c0f86dc7d468524.png[/img][/url]

Remember those days when you went to school? Or do you still go to school? This achievement will make you feel like you're in a real... we're kidding.

Purchase the first skill to unlock this achievement. This skill will REALLY come in handy for you.

[b]7. Rambo[/b]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/4ff6b37e44b515dc966f89242472f739569f7e05.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/75c3cc390a98acf24e676149bbe863074c2ce7bf.png[/img][/url]

I don't think we need to explain...


[b]That's all we wanted to show you today. 
Let us know in the comments which achievement you like best![/b]

And if you've earned all of the achievements while playing the demo, join our Discord server where we look forward to seeing your screenshots!

[url=https://discord.gg/m3gTQxE][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/b3f6f33f04fc3e96c985cbc03392b5f70fec42d9.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/b3f6f33f04fc3e96c985cbc03392b5f70fec42d9.gif[/img][/url][/url]

Cheers!
